issue.title: NEIGH_TABLE not populated with VXLAN routes

failure.body:
Observed on master and 202405 (with PR #3383 applied to make VXLANs actually work).

Basic architecture is VXLAN EVPN with an irb/svi vni interface on the switches participating in the vxlan fabric.
```
|------------| <IP>             |---------------------------------|
|    host    |-----------------------|             sonic1              |
|------------|             Ethernet8 | Loopback0: <IP>           |
                           Untagged  | VLAN 2/VNI 10002 irb: <IP> |
                           VLAN2     |---------------------------------|
                           VNI 10002                 | Ethernet54
                                                     | BGP Unnumbered
                                                     |
                                                     |
                                          Ethernet54 |
                                      BGP Unnumbered |
                                     |---------------------------------|
                                     |              sonic2             |
                                     | Loopback0: <IP>           |
                                     | VLAN 2/VNI 10002 irb: <IP> |
                                     |---------------------------------|
```

In `sw2` I've noticed log entries like:
```
2024 Nov 20 <IPV6>.482102 sw2 WARNING swss#arp_update[900]: 108 MAC mismatch for <IP> on Vlan2 - kernel: <IPV6>, APPL_DB:
```

Then when I investigate, `NEIGH_TABLE` in `APPL_DB` doesn't have any neighbors listed for Vlan2.
```
# sonic-db-dump -n APPL_DB -y -k "NEIGH_TABLE:Vlan2:*"
{}
```

But the kernel has the neighbor listed as added by BGP/Zebra:
```
root@sw2:~# ip neigh show dev Vlan2
<IP> lladdr <IPV6> extern_learn NOARP proto zebra
<IP> lladdr <IPV6> extern_learn NOARP proto zebra
fe80::<IPV6> lladdr <IPV6> extern_learn NOARP proto zebra
```

And the type-2 routes look good:
```
# vtysh -c "show bgp l2vpn evpn"
BGP table version is 7, local router ID is <IP>
Status codes: s suppressed, d damped, h history, * valid, > best, i - internal
Origin codes: i - IGP, e - EGP, ? - incomplete
EVPN type-1 prefix: [1]:[EthTag]:[ESI]:[IPlen]:[VTEP-IP]:[Frag-id]
EVPN type-2 prefix: [2]:[EthTag]:[MAClen]:[MAC]:[IPlen]:[IP]
EVPN type-3 prefix: [3]:[EthTag]:[IPlen]:[OrigIP]
EVPN type-4 prefix: [4]:[ESI]:[IPlen]:[OrigIP]
EVPN type-5 prefix: [5]:[EthTag]:[IPlen]:[IP]

   Network          Next Hop            Metric LocPrf Weight Path
Route Distinguisher: <IP>:2
 *> [2]:[0]:[48]:[<IPV6>]
                    <IP>                             0 4210000001 i
                    RT:32897:10002 ET:8
 *> [2]:[0]:[48]:[<IPV6>]:[32]:[<IP>]
                    <IP>                             0 4210000001 i
                    RT:32897:10002 ET:8
 *> [2]:[0]:[48]:[<IPV6>]:[32]:[<IP>]
                    <IP>                             0 4210000001 i
                    RT:32897:10002 ET:8
 *> [2]:[0]:[48]:[<IPV6>]:[128]:[fe80::<IPV6>]
                    <IP>                             0 4210000001 i
                    RT:32897:10002 ET:8
 *> [3]:[0]:[32]:[<IP>]
                    <IP>                             0 4210000001 i
                    RT:32897:10002 ET:8
Route Distinguisher: <IP>:2
 *> [2]:[0]:[48]:[<IPV6>]:[32]:[<IP>]
                    <IP>                         32768 i
                    ET:8 RT:32898:10002
 *> [2]:[0]:[48]:[<IPV6>]:[128]:[fe80::<IPV6>]
                    <IP>                         32768 i
                    ET:8 RT:32898:10002
 *> [3]:[0]:[32]:[<IP>]
                    <IP>                         32768 i
                    ET:8 RT:32898:10002

Displayed 8 out of 8 total prefixes
```

Going over to the originating VTEP (`sw1`) where the host is directly connected, the NEIGH_TABLE is populated as expected:
```
# sonic-db-dump -n APPL_DB -y -k "NEIGH_TABLE:Vlan2:*"
{
  "NEIGH_TABLE:Vlan2:<IP>": {
    "expireat": 1732144228.8517292,
    "ttl": -0.001,
    "type": "hash",
    "value": {
      "family": "IPv4",
      "neigh": "<IPV6>"
    }
  }
}
```

And we see these log entries.
```
2024 Nov 20 <IPV6>.369623 sw1 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addNeighbor: Created neighbor ip <IP>, <IPV6> on Vlan2
2024 Nov 20 <IPV6>.370310 sw1 NOTICE syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_NEXT_HOP:brcm_sai_create_next_hop:334 nhid 3 vr_id 0 ip af:v4 addr:<IP> rif-id 1 tunnel-id 0 vni 0
2024 Nov 20 <IPV6>.370474 sw1 NOTICE syncd#syncd: [none] SAI_API_NEXT_HOP:_brcm_sai_xgs_create_ip_nexthop:554 nhid 3 eg-if 400004 rif 0 vid 0 port/tid(0x0) is_trunk(0)
2024 Nov 20 <IPV6>.371069 sw1 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addNextHop: Created next hop <IP> on Vlan2
```

I'm assuming there is some event that should cause population of the `NEIGH_TABLE` on `sw2`, which likely should also trigger off programming of the neighbor into the ASIC.  Since this is not happening it is a violation of the HLD:
https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/vxlan/EVPN/EVPN_VXLAN_HLD.md#438-mac-ip-route-handling

Likely this is at least part of the underlying cause of the svi not being able to speak to neighbors across the vxlan.

resolution.title: [neighsync] bug: VXLAN EVPN neighbors not in NEIGH_TABLE
resolution.description:
**Why I did it**

VXLAN EVPN learned routes are not entered into NEIGH_TABLE as per Issue #3384.

The EVPN VXLAN HLD specifically states this should be populated so it triggers an update to the SAI database:

https://github.com/sonic-net/SONiC/blob/master/doc/vxlan/EVPN/EVPN_VXLAN_HLD.md#438-mac-ip-route-handling

> The remote MAC-IP routes will be installed by BGP (Zebra) in Linux neighbor table against Vlan netdevice. Neighsyncd subscribes to neighbor entries and will receive remote MAC-IP bindings as well. These entries will continue to go into NEIGH_TABLE in APP_DB, and neighorch will update SAI database.

It appears this was mistakingly introduced in #943 with a short conversation here about the reason, but it didn't take into account other reasons for NOARP entries: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/pull/943/files#r332867379

**What I did**

The reason it was not occurring is NOARP entries were being rejected, this patch adds an exception for externally learned neighbors (which have NOARP set).

**How I verified it**

Installed on a physical switch and observe remotely learned neighbors are present in NEIGH_TABLE

**Details if related**

Fixes #3384
Signed-off-by: Brad House (@bradh352)
